info.title: WeGotWorkspace API
info.description: Parallel OpenAPI-first REST API for all app domains.

installChannel.description: Install channel: `docker` disables Admin web updater; `zip` or null uses ZIP in-container updates.

imageTag.description: Docker image tag from WGW_IMAGE when install channel is docker.

hasShares.description: True when this path has direct outgoing share grants (member, guest, or public).

hasPublicShare.description: True when this path has an active public link share.

hasTeamShare.description: True when this path has active team grants (users or groups) on a member share.

groupSlug.description: Group slug when scope is group, null for personal notes.

updatedAt.description: Metadata concurrency token from the frontmatter `updated` marker. Body-only collab saves do not advance this value.

contentUpdatedAt.description: File mtime for the note document. Advances when the body is rewritten (including collab saves). Prefer for list/footer “last edited” display; use updatedAt for offline ifInState guards.

hasShares.description: True when this note file or its notebook directory has direct outgoing share grants (member/team or public). Omitted or false when the owner has not shared the note.

hasPublicShare.description: True when this note file or its notebook directory has an active public link share.

hasTeamShare.description: True when this note file or its notebook directory has active team grants (users or groups).

body.description: Optional. Omit the field entirely to update metadata only and preserve the existing body bytes on disk. Sending it (including an empty string) overwrites the body.

groupSlug.description: Target a shared group notebook (groups/{slug}/.notes). Omit or null for the caller's personal notes. Caller must be a group member.
Group slug when deleting a note under groups/{slug}/.notes. Omit or null for personal notes.

scope.description: personal = caller-owned notebook; group = membership notebook under groups/{slug}/.notes.

groupSlug.description: Group slug when scope is group; null/omitted for personal notebooks.

hasShares.description: Deprecated for notebook rows — personal notebook-directory shares are unsupported. Omitted/false on group-membership rows.

mayRead.description: May fetch cards in this address book.

mayWrite.description: May create, update, delete, or move cards.

mayDelete.description: May delete the address book itself.

sortOrder.description: UI sort order; lower values appear first.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the book is shown in client UI.

shareWith.description: Principal id to rights map; null when not shared.

myRights.description: Current user's access rights for this book.

@type.description: JSContact Card type discriminator (server-set on responses).

addressBookIds.description: Set of address book ids; each value MUST be true.

uid.description: Cross-system card identifier (RFC 9553; optional in JSContact 2.0 per RFC 9982). Required for JMAP Contacts (RFC 9610).

state.description: Opaque JMAP state token for Contact/set ifInState (RFC 9610).

members.description: Group member uids when kind is group.

vCardProps.description: RFC 9555 unmapped vCard properties (conversion base spec; uid rules updated by RFC 9982 for JSContact 2.0).

ContactCard.description: RFC 9610 ContactCard — full JMAP ContactCard returned by GET/POST/PUT responses. Server-owned `id`, `@type`, and `version` are read-only; use ContactCardCreate for POST/PUT request bodies.

JsContactAddress.description: RFC 9553 Address — at least one of components, coordinates, countryCode, full, or timeZone MUST be set.

JsContactIdAddressMap.description: RFC 9553 addresses map — nested `@type` on values and AddressComponent entries is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdSchedulingAddressMap.description: RFC 9553 schedulingAddresses map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

number.description: tel:, sip:, or free-text phone number.

features.description: Feature flags: mobile, voice, text, video, main-number, textphone, fax, pager.

JsContactOnlineService.description: RFC 9553 OnlineService — at least one of uri or user MUST be set.

JsContactIdEmailAddressMap.description: RFC 9553 emails map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdPhoneMap.description: RFC 9553 phones map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdOnlineServiceMap.description: RFC 9553 onlineServices map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdLanguagePrefMap.description: RFC 9553 preferredLanguages map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

relation.description: Relation types: acquaintance, agent, child, co-resident, co-worker, colleague, contact, crush, date, emergency, friend, kin, me, met, muse, neighbor, parent, sibling, spouse, sweetheart.

JsContactAuthor.description: RFC 9553 Author — at least one of name or uri MUST be set.

JsContactIdAnniversaryMap.description: RFC 9553 anniversaries map — nested `@type` on values, date, and place is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdNoteMap.description: RFC 9553 notes map — nested `@type` on values and author is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdPersonalInfoMap.description: RFC 9553 personalInfo map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactName.description: RFC 9553 Name — at least one of components or full MUST be set.

JsContactOrganization.description: RFC 9553 Organization — at least one of name or units MUST be set.

JsContactSpeakToAs.description: RFC 9553 SpeakToAs — at least one of grammaticalGender or pronouns MUST be set.

JsContactIdNicknameMap.description: RFC 9553 nicknames map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdOrganizationMap.description: RFC 9553 organizations map — nested `@type` on values and OrgUnit entries is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdTitleMap.description: RFC 9553 titles map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

blobId.description: JMAP blob id (RFC 9610); replaces data: URI on read.

JsContactMedia.description: RFC 9553 Media with JMAP blobId extension.

JsContactIdCalendarMap.description: RFC 9553 calendars map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdCryptoKeyMap.description: RFC 9553 cryptoKeys map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdDirectoryMap.description: RFC 9553 directories map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdLinkMap.description: RFC 9553 links map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactIdMediaMap.description: RFC 9553 media map — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactId.description: RFC 9553 Id — base64url alphabet without padding.

JsContactUTCDateTime.description: RFC 9553 UTCDateTime — RFC 3339 date-time with Z offset.

JsContactIdBooleanMap.description: RFC 9553 Id[Boolean] set keyed by JsContact Id (addressBookIds, members). Nested `@type` not applicable.

JsContactStringRelationMap.description: RFC 9553 String[Relation] map (relatedTo) — nested `@type` on values is optional (RFC 9553 §1.3.4).

JsContactJCardProp.description: RFC 9555 JCardProp — jCard property tuple [name, params, valueType, value].

addressBookIds.description: Set of address book ids; each value MUST be true.

ContactCardCreate.description: POST/PUT request body for contact cards. Omits server-owned `id`, `@type`, and `version`. Nested `@type` on map values is optional per RFC 9553 §1.3.4.

addressBookIds.description: Set of address book ids; each value MUST be true. Map entry null removes membership.

members.description: Group member uids when kind is group. Map entry null removes member.

ContactCardPatch.description: PATCH request body for partial contact card updates. Omits server-owned `id`, `@type`, and `version`. Id-keyed map entries merge by key; null removes an entry. Nested objects (e.g. name) deep-merge.

blobId.description: Opaque blob identifier for contact media (RFC 9610 blobId).

type.description: MIME media type of the uploaded blob.

id.description: Optional client-suggested address book id (uri slug).

onDestroyRemoveContents.description: When true, delete all cards in the book before destroying it.

oldState.description: Previous sync state token supplied by the client.

newState.description: Current sync state token to store for the next request.

DavEtag.description: Quoted HTTP entity tag aligned with Cal/CardDAV storage (Sabre PDO etag).

CalendarEventRecurrenceOverride.description: Per-instance patch keyed by recurrence id (original instance start). Use excluded:true to omit an instance.

byMonth.description: Month numbers as strings, optionally with leap-month suffix, e.g. "3L" (RFC 8984 §4.3.3).

offset.description: Signed ISO 8601 duration relative to event start or end (e.g. -PT15M).

recurrenceId.description: Original instance start for expanded or override rows; null on series masters.

recurrenceRules.description: RRULE on series masters; null on expanded instances.

recurrenceOverrides.description: Per-instance patches keyed by recurrence id (original instance start). Maps to RECURRENCE-ID override VEVENTs in ICS.

alerts.description: Reminder alarms mapped from iCalendar VALARM components.

state.description: Opaque JMAP state token for CalendarEvent/set ifInState.

CalendarEvent.description: JMAP CalendarEvent mapped from a single VEVENT ICS resource.

CalendarEventCreate.description: POST body; server assigns id and @type.

recurrenceOverrides.description: Per-instance patches keyed by recurrence id (original instance start). Maps to RECURRENCE-ID override VEVENTs in ICS.

alerts.description: Reminder alarms mapped from iCalendar VALARM components.

CalendarEventPatch.description: PATCH request body for partial calendar event updates. Omits server-owned id and @type.

JmapId.description: JMAP id string (calendar uri, event id, map key).

JmapIdBooleanMap.description: Map of ids to true booleans.

JmapLocalDateTime.description: Local or UTC date-time without required Z suffix.

groupSlug.description: Group slug when scope is group; null for personal task lists.

relativeTo.description: Relative to task start (DTSTART) or end/due (DUE)

when.description: UTC date-time when the alert fires

excluded.description: When true, exclude this recurrence instance (EXDATE)

recurrenceRules.description: RRULE-only; clients expand instances per JMAP Tasks draft.

excludedRecurrenceDates.description: EXDATE values for excluded recurrence instances.

recurrenceOverrides.description: Per-instance patches keyed by recurrence id (RECURRENCE-ID).

alerts.description: Task reminders mapped from VALARM components.

icsProps.description: Unmapped VTODO properties preserved for round-trip fidelity.

groupSlug.description: When set, create the task list on this group principal (groups/{slug}). Omit for personal scope.

destroy.description: Card ids to destroy, or map of id to { ifInState }.

UnifiedSearchResult.description: A single unified search hit across files, notes, calendar, and contacts.

UnifiedSearchFilters.description: Normalized filters echoed back on the search response.

UnifiedSearchResponse.description: REST response for GET /search/results, including offset/hasMore pagination.

SearchDocumentSyncDto.description: Auth-scoped search index row for offline client sync (includes bodyText).

SearchDocumentChangesResponse.description: JMAP-style delta for search index documents.

DriveShareAccess.description: Share access level for a grant or default access. Note paths (…/.notes/…) accept view|edit only; comment, legacy review, and full are rejected.

DriveRights.description: Effective drive rights for the current principal on a path or share.

DriveShareShareWithMap.description: Map of username, groups/{slug}, or email to grant entry; null value removes the grant. On CRUD responses, contains active user and group grants only — pending email invites are omitted (see effectiveGrants on at-path).

shareWith.description: Active user and group grants only (PATCH-editable). Pending email invites are not included — use effectiveGrants on GET /files/shares/at-path for the full principal overview.

entry.description: Resolved filesystem metadata for the share path when it still exists. Clients should prefer this over listing the parent directory — grantees often cannot list ancestors outside the share root.

viaGroup.description: Present when access is group-only (groups/{slug} grant). Omitted when the caller has a direct user grant on the same share.

DriveShareAtPathEntryStatus.description: Share lifecycle status for owner overview. Expired shares remain visible but do not confer live access.

inherited.description: true when sharePath !== requested path (ancestor or descendant).

status.description: Share lifecycle status (active or expired). Distinct from top-level invite/grant status on grant rows.

invitedEmail.description: Original invite email for accepted guest user grants.

displayName.description: Group display name when principalType is group.

memberCount.description: Group member count when principalType is group.

DriveShareEffectiveGrant.description: Resolved grant overview at a path — one row per principal with winning access and provenance.

DriveSharePublicSummary.description: Owner overview of applicable public shares in the audit subtree (direct, ancestor, and descendant). Guest sessions remain 1:1 bound to a single share token — no prefix-winner resolution.

grantSources.description: Subtree audit rows — all non-revoked grant sources on direct, ancestor, and descendant shares (including expired shares).

effectiveGrants.description: Resolved grants — one row per principal with winning access.

publicShares.description: Public shares in the audit subtree (direct, ancestor, and descendant), including expired links.

principal.description: Username or groups/{slug} for patchShareWith removal.

DriveShareGrantSourceEntry.description: Raw grant row before resolver merge — one entry per overlapping grant source in the audit subtree (direct, ancestor, and descendant shares).

viaGroup.description: groups/{slug} when winning access is via a group grant; null when direct user grant wins.

DriveShareMemberAccess.description: Per-user resolved access for the team panel, with group expansion and editability hints.

principalType.description: Grant row type (user, group, or email) — same semantics as effectiveGrants grantSources, not the queried principal.

status.description: Invite/grant status (pending or active). Share lifecycle is on source.status.

invitedEmail.description: Original invite email for accepted guest user grants.

viaGroup.description: Present when a user principal matched via a group grant (groups/{slug}).

DriveShareByPrincipalEntry.description: One grant row for the queried principal — audit list without resolver merge.

principal.description: Queried username, groups/{slug}, or email address (normalized from the principal query parameter).

queriedPrincipalType.description: Type inferred from the principal query parameter (user, group, or email).

path.description: Virtual drive path of the shared note (…/.notes/{notebook}/{id}.md).

title.description: List preview for the shared note. Prefer on-disk body text (Notes has no separate title field); frontmatter title is used only when the body is empty and is not the placeholder Untitled or the note id. Empty when there is no usable preview — never a raw note id such as local-*.

tags.description: Tags from the note markdown frontmatter. Empty when the file is missing or has no tags.

owner.description: Username or group slug that owns the note tree.

viaGroup.description: Present when access is via a group grant (groups/{slug}).

path.description: Virtual drive path of the shared notebook directory (…/.notes/{notebook}).

owner.description: Username or group slug that owns the notebook tree.

viaGroup.description: Present when access is via a group grant (groups/{slug}).

notes.description: Compat empty array — personal ACL notebook-directory shares were removed. Group-membership notes come from GET /notes/items.

nthOfPeriod.description: Occurrence within the period, e.g. 2 = second, -1 = last (RFC 8984 §4.3.3).

CalendarEventSetRequest.description: RFC 8620 §5.3 /set arguments subset. Deliberate divergence: ifInState is per record (update/destroy entries carry their own per-event state token) instead of a single request-level ifInState.

create.description: Map of client-chosen creation id to the event to create; the creation id keys the created/notCreated response maps.

update.description: Map of event id to patch; optional ifInState is resolved against the event state token.

destroy.description: Event ids to destroy, or map of id to { ifInState }.

CalendarSetError.description: RFC 8620 §5.3 SetError. Types: notFound, invalidProperties (with properties listing the offending paths), forbidden, serverFail, and stateMismatch (per-record ifInState divergence — see CalendarEventSetRequest).

properties.description: Offending property paths; present when type is invalidProperties.

CalendarEventSetCreated.description: Server-set properties of a created event (RFC 8620 §5.3): the server-assigned id and the event's state token.

CalendarEventSetResponse.description: RFC 8620 §5.3 /set response. oldState/newState are the same per-calendar sync state /changes uses, scoped to the calendars touched by the request: a single calendar's plain synctoken, or the `{count}:{uri:token,...}` composite (sorted by uri) when the request spans calendars. When nothing was mutated the scope falls back to every owned VEVENT calendar and oldState equals newState.

oldState.description: Touched-calendar sync state before the mutations (null only when unknowable).

newState.description: Touched-calendar sync state after the mutations.

created.description: Map of client creation id to server-set properties of the created event.

updated.description: Map of updated event id to the server-changed properties (the rotated state token), or null when the server changed nothing beyond the client patch.

after.description: Inclusive lower bound; an event matches when one of its occurrences intersects [after, before). Requires before.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event title.

queryState.description: RFC 8620 §5.5. Same state string /changes uses, composed across filter.inCalendars: a single calendar's plain synctoken, or the `{count}:{uri:token,...}` composite sorted by uri.

canCalculateChanges.description: Always false: CalendarEvent/queryChanges is not implemented.

JmapSession.description: JMAP Session resource (RFC 8620 §2). One account per authenticated principal; accountId is the raw username. All URLs are absolute.

capabilities.description: Session-level capabilities. `urn:ietf:params:jmap:core` carries the limits object; `urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars` is the empty object (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-27 §1.5.1).

get.description: JMAP CalendarEvent/changes mapping over the CalDAV calendarchanges log. Multi-VEVENT objects emit one composite id `{objectId}#{uid}` per VEVENT; destroyed ids include every id previously surfaced over REST for the destroyed object. The full delta is always returned in one response: `maxChanges` is accepted (RFC 8620 §5.2) but not used for truncation because the backing Sabre changes log cannot produce a safe intermediate sync token, so `hasMoreChanges` is always false.

parameters.name: maxChanges
parameters.description: RFC 8620 §5.2 maxChanges. Validated (positive integer) but not used for truncation; the full delta is always returned and hasMoreChanges is always false.

post.description: RFC 8620 §5.3 response semantics: `created` maps creation id to the server-set properties `{id, state}`, `updated` maps event id to the server-changed properties `{state}`. Top-level `oldState`/`newState` are the same per-calendar sync state `/calendars/events/changes` uses, scoped to the calendars touched by the request (single calendar: plain synctoken; multiple: `{count}:{uri:token,...}` composite sorted by uri; nothing mutated: all owned VEVENT calendars, oldState equals newState). Deliberate divergence: `ifInState` is per record (update/destroy entries carry their own per-event state token, stale token yields SetError type `stateMismatch`) instead of a request-level ifInState.

JMAP CalendarEvent/query mapping: filter by calendar ids, time range, and title text. Time-range matching is per VEVENT (composite ids match on their own occurrences, including recurrence expansion). Returns `queryState` (the same state string `/calendars/events/changes` uses, composed across `filter.inCalendars`) and `canCalculateChanges: false` (CalendarEvent/queryChanges is not implemented) per RFC 8620 §5.5.

get.description: RFC 8620 §2 Session resource for the calendars JMAP envelope. One account per authenticated principal (accountId = username); all URLs absolute; session-level calendars capability is the empty object per draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-27 §1.5.1.
Structurally required by the Session resource (RFC 8620 §6.2) but unused by the calendars client; returns 501.

get.description: Structurally required by the Session resource (RFC 8620 §7.3) but push is a non-goal; the shipped client polls. Returns 501.
